claims: As of March 2026, the head men's basketball coach at Villanova University is Kevin Willard.
Kevin Willard was named the William B. Finneran Endowed Head Coach in March 2025, succeeding Kyle Neptune.
Prior to joining Villanova, Kevin Willard was the head coach at Maryland.
Prior to joining Villanova, Kevin Willard was the head coach at Seton Hall.
In his first season leading the Wildcats, Kevin Willard guided the team to the NCAA Tournament.
During the 2026 NCAA Tournament, Kevin Willard made headlines for joking in a mid-game interview that he would "fire" his coaching staff due to poor performance against Utah State.
The 2025-26 coaching staff includes assistants David Cox, Kevin Norris, and Ashley Howard.
